tools.name: healthgorilla_find_patients
tools.description: Search for patients by demographics. FHIR: GET /Patient?given=&family=&birthdate=&identifier=. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle. Use the returned Patient id with the other tools.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_patient
tools.description: Read a single patient by id. FHIR: GET /Patient/{id}. Returns a FHIR Patient resource.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_patient_everything
tools.description: Fetch the comprehensive record for a patient as a FHIR Bundle. FHIR: GET /Patient/{id}/$everything. Optionally scope by _since and page with _count.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_conditions
tools.description: List a patient's conditions/problems. FHIR: GET /Condition?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_medications
tools.description: List a patient's medication requests/prescriptions. FHIR: GET /MedicationRequest?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_allergies
tools.description: List a patient's allergies/intolerances. FHIR: GET /AllergyIntolerance?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_immunizations
tools.description: List a patient's immunizations. FHIR: GET /Immunization?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_observations
tools.description: List a patient's observations (labs, vitals). FHIR: GET /Observation?patient={id}. Filter by category (e.g. laboratory, vital-signs), LOINC code, or date. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_diagnostic_reports
tools.description: List a patient's diagnostic reports (lab panels, imaging). FHIR: GET /DiagnosticReport?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_documents
tools.description: List a patient's document references (C-CDA, notes, etc). FHIR: GET /DocumentReference?patient={id}. Each entry points at a Binary you can fetch with healthgorilla_get_binary.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_coverage
tools.description: List a patient's insurance coverage. FHIR: GET /Coverage?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_binary
tools.description: Retrieve raw document content by Binary id. FHIR: GET /Binary/{id}. Content may be a FHIR Binary JSON resource, XML C-CDA, or base64 — returned as-is (raw text if not JSON).

tools.name: healthgorilla_poll_query_status
tools.description: Poll a RequestResult URL returned by healthgorilla_start_patient360_query. HTTP 202 = still processing, 200 = done (returns retrieval metrics: organizationsTotal, documentsFound, documentsImported, documentsSkipped, documentsFailed). Returns { status, body }.

tools.name: healthgorilla_fhir_search
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary FHIR search. GET /{resource_type}?{query}. e.g. resource_type='Observation', query='patient=123&category=laboratory&_count=5'. Use when a dedicated tool does not cover your query.

tools.name: healthgorilla_create_patient
tools.description: Registers a NEW patient record in your Health Gorilla tenant. FHIR: POST /Patient with a minimal FHIR R4 Patient resource built from the given args. State-changing.

tools.name: healthgorilla_start_patient360_query
tools.description: Initiates an asynchronous national-network records retrieval (CommonWell / Carequality / QHINs) that imports external documents into your tenant. FHIR: GET /DocumentReference/$p360-retrieve?patient={id} with header 'Prefer: respond-async'. Returns the RequestResult poll URL (Location header); poll i

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "healthgorilla_list_observations" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: healthgorilla_start_patient360_query · Private data: healthgorilla_get_patient_everything, healthgorilla_list_documents, healthgorilla_get_binary, healthgorilla_create_patient, healthgorilla_start_patient360_query · Public sink: healthgorilla_create_patient · Destructive: healthgorilla_fhir_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: healthgorilla_start_patient360_query · Private data: healthgorilla_get_patient_everything, healthgorilla_list_documents, healthgorilla_get_binary, healthgorilla_create_patient, healthgorilla_start_patient360_query · Public sink: healthgorilla_create_patient · Destructive: healthgorilla_fhir_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
